items.summary: An improper validation of the specified type of input in Axis Camera Station Pro and Axis Camera Station 5 could allow an attacker to compromise the system. Axis rates it critical; affected versions are Camera Station Pro below 6.17 and Camera Station 5 below 5.59 SR2.

SAP NetWeaver lacks necessary authorization checks and sufficient input validation in certain remote-enabled functionality. A low-privileged attacker could send specially crafted input through a remote interface to inject and execute code.

SAP NetWeaver Knowledge Management (XML Forms) does not sufficiently restrict the selection of XSL transformations it processes. Under certain conditions, an authenticated user with access to the affected functionality could inject and execute code.
Improper authentication in Azure DevOps Server allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network. Microsoft published the flaw in its November 2026 Patch Tuesday release.

An improper encoding or escaping of output flaw in Fortinet FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer (including Cloud and BigData editions) may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via a specially crafted HTTP request when the JSON API is enabled.
